$ agenthub modules
[exit 0]
--- stdout
  assistant    Personal assistant: question reconciliation, channel leases
✓ backup       Nightly encrypted cloud backup + monthly restore test
  claude       Claude Code login check, updates, headless token expiry reminders
  consolidate  Nightly: folds memory date files older than 14 days into reference/ (before the librarian)
  mirror       Nightly: updates the --mirror clone of every repo in mirror-list.txt
  owner        Built-in owner side: notices of new to-dos and questions (close and answer with agenthub owner)
✓ reflect      Every Monday: the previous week's cross-project review (reflect/)
  sandbox      Platform-run capabilities (cap-runner): sandboxed projects borrow a capability with hub-run --cap

switch: hub modules enable|disable <name> (changes modules in hub.json, then applies)
--- stderr

$ agenthub modules enable no-such-module
[exit 1]
--- stdout
--- stderr
hub modules: no module no-such-module (modules/ has: assistant, backup, claude, consolidate, mirror, owner, reflect, sandbox)

$ agenthub modules enable mirror
[exit 0]
--- stdout
hub.json:modules.mirror = true
[agenthub config apply]
remember to commit hub.json (config as code).
--- stderr

$ agenthub modules disable backup
[exit 1]
--- stdout
hub.json:modules.backup = false
[agenthub config apply]
remember to commit hub.json (config as code).
--- stderr

=== hub.json modules
{"backup": false, "reflect": true, "mirror": true}
